_comment: Phase 11 power-path floorplan for the r3 placement draft (project choice, not derived): the chain runs J1 VBUS -> D5 / Q3 (U3 beside) -> U2 (IN on top, OUT at the bottom) -> VBUS_P to C3 and Q1 -> VBUS_OUT to JOUT1.1/.2. Reserved rectangles keep the 5 A corridors free of other footprints (mm, KiCad board coordinates). U1 moves 2.67 mm right of its as-built x (14.4 vs 11.728) so the VBUS_P corridors pass on its left without displacing the RESET and local-clamp parts from their pins.
